objective: Aislar sin tocar nada la coexistencia de dbo.Usuario_Modulos y dbo.Sistema_Modulos en EDARSAHUB y determinar con evidencia cual participa en autorizacion RBAC efectiva y cual participa en navegacion/menu. Auditar repositorio y SQL runtime. No elegir por intuicion, no modificar codigo, permisos, roles, menus, usuarios ni datos. Confirmar especificamente como Usuario_PermisosRolModulo.ModuloID se relaciona con cada catalogo y cual usa require_explicit_permission / RBACRepositorySQL / RBACContextService frente a MenuService.

queries.name: objects_exist
queries.sql: SELECT OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(o.object_id) AS schema_name,o.name,o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o WHERE o.object_id IN (OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Usuario_Modulos'),OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Sistema_Modulos'),OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Usuario_PermisosRolModulo'),OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Usuario_Acciones')) ORDER BY o.name;

queries.name: usuario_modulos_columns
queries.sql: SELECT c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,TYPE_NAME(c.user_type_id) AS data_type FROM sys.columns c WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Usuario_Modulos') ORDER BY c.column_id;

queries.name: sistema_modulos_columns
queries.sql: SELECT c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,TYPE_NAME(c.user_type_id) AS data_type FROM sys.columns c WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Sistema_Modulos') ORDER BY c.column_id;

queries.name: permiso_fk_targets
queries.sql: SELECT fk.name AS fk_name,OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) AS parent_schema,OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) AS parent_table,pc.name AS parent_column,OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) AS referenced_schema,OBJECT_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) AS referenced_table,rc.name AS referenced_column,fk.is_disabled,fk.is_not_trusted FROM sys.foreign_keys fk INNER JOIN sys.foreign_key_columns fkc ON fkc.constraint_object_id=fk.object_id INNER JOIN sys.columns pc ON pc.object_id=fkc.parent_object_id AND pc.column_id=fkc.parent_column_id INNER JOIN sys.columns rc ON rc.object_id=fkc.referenced_object_id AND rc.column_id=fkc.referenced_column_id WHERE fk.parent_object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Usuario_PermisosRolModulo') ORDER BY fk.name;

queries.name: cava_in_usuario_modulos
queries.sql: SELECT ModuloID,CodigoModulo,NombreModulo,Ruta,Activo FROM dbo.Usuario_Modulos WHERE LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(CodigoModulo))) LIKE N'cava_socios%' ORDER BY CodigoModulo;

queries.name: cava_in_sistema_modulos
queries.sql: SELECT ModuloID,Codigo,Nombre,URLExterna,Activo FROM dbo.Sistema_Modulos WHERE LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(Codigo))) LIKE N'cava_socios%' OR LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(Nombre))) LIKE N'%cava%' ORDER BY Codigo;

queries.name: permission_join_usuario_modulos
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (100) prm.PermisoRolModuloID,prm.RolID,prm.ModuloID,um.CodigoModulo,ua.CodigoAccion,prm.Permitido,prm.Activo FROM dbo.Usuario_PermisosRolModulo prm INNER JOIN dbo.Usuario_Modulos um ON um.ModuloID=prm.ModuloID INNER JOIN dbo.Usuario_Acciones ua ON ua.AccionID=prm.AccionID WHERE LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(um.CodigoModulo))) LIKE N'cava_socios%' ORDER BY prm.RolID,um.CodigoModulo,ua.CodigoAccion;

queries.name: permission_join_sistema_modulos_overlap
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (100) prm.PermisoRolModuloID,prm.RolID,prm.ModuloID,sm.Codigo,sm.Nombre,prm.Permitido,prm.Activo FROM dbo.Usuario_PermisosRolModulo prm INNER JOIN dbo.Sistema_Modulos sm ON sm.ModuloID=prm.ModuloID WHERE LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(sm.Codigo))) LIKE N'cava_socios%' OR LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(sm.Nombre))) LIKE N'%cava%' ORDER BY prm.RolID,sm.Codigo;

queries.name: module_id_collision_check
queries.sql: SELECT um.ModuloID,um.CodigoModulo AS usuario_codigo,um.NombreModulo AS usuario_nombre,sm.Codigo AS sistema_codigo,sm.Nombre AS sistema_nombre FROM dbo.Usuario_Modulos um INNER JOIN dbo.Sistema_Modulos sm ON sm.ModuloID=um.ModuloID WHERE LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(um.CodigoModulo))) LIKE N'cava_socios%' OR LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(sm.Codigo))) LIKE N'cava_socios%' OR LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(sm.Nombre))) LIKE N'%cava%' ORDER BY um.ModuloID;

constraints: Do not assume Usuario_Modulos or Sistema_Modulos is canonical before evidence
EDARSAHUB SQL Server remains source of truth
